subject.title: Browserbase integration broken: static cdpUrl returns 404, needs session API

question: Should Browserbase session lifecycle be supported as a first-party browser profile driver now, routed through a generic browser-backend/plugin seam first, or reduced to documentation that no longer recommends the static URL path?
rationale: The remaining fix crosses a commercial-service integration, browser-control security, credential handling, config/schema surface, and session lifecycle policy, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product boundary.

options.title: Revise Browserbase driver PR
options.body: Accept a first-party driver only after route coverage, credential contract, signed URL redaction, cleanup semantics, and live OpenClaw browser-tool proof are resolved.

options.title: Design backend seam first
options.body: Keep this issue tied to the broader browser backend/plugin interface so Browserbase can ship outside core once the registration contract exists.

options.title: Document limitation
options.body: Remove or narrow the Browserbase static-CDP instructions until maintainers are ready to support the Sessions API lifecycle in product code.

recommendation.title: Revise Browserbase driver PR
recommendation.body: Accept a first-party driver only after route coverage, credential contract, signed URL redaction, cleanup semantics, and live OpenClaw browser-tool proof are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision cuts across the browser runtime, plugin boundary, and security-sensitive config surfaces where recent history points most strongly to steipete.
